# High Pressure Fuel Pump Direct Injection Test

**Make**: VW
**Model**: Golf
**Year**: 2012
**Diagnostic Code**: P0087

## Description and Procedure
Low fuel rail pressure under load causes hesitation. Inspect HPFP camshaft follower and spill valve solenoid connector.
Vehicle system troubleshooting guidance for P0087 on 2012 VW Golf.
Always adhere to shop safety practices when servicing engine systems.
